nodes.label: District Court Transferred Cases
nodes.summary: Transfer to DC, dismissal application, trial procedure, sentencing powers, appeal route.

nodes.label: Transfer to District Court
nodes.summary: Secretary for Justice applies to magistrate; order if appropriate (Cap 221 s.77C). Notice of transfer served; no committal proceedings needed.

nodes.label: Dismissal Application
nodes.summary: Accused may apply to DC to dismiss charge on ground of no case or abuse (Cap 221 s.77E). Test: same as no-case submission in CFI.

nodes.label: Criminal Procedure Ordinance (Cap 221) s.77E
nodes.summary: DC dismissal application on ground of no case or abuse.

nodes.label: District Court Trial Procedure
nodes.summary: Judge alone; no jury. Arraignment, plea, trial; evidence and submissions. Sentencing powers: up to 7 years (or aggregate). Appeal route: to Court of Appeal against conviction/sentence (Cap 221 ss.83B-83U).

nodes.label: Criminal Procedure Ordinance (Cap 221) ss.83B-83U
nodes.summary: Appeal route from DC to Court of Appeal against conviction/sentence.
